facts.fact: BEAU 在十点（ten）前已重建半个前悬挂、与供应商争论 defective alternator，并第三次（third time）听 Dad 解释退休不等于不用再纠正 Jax 整理工具箱的方式。
facts.anchor: By ten that morning, I had already rebuilt half a front suspension, argued with a supplier over a defective alternator, and listened to Dad explain for the third time that retirement did not mean he had to stop correcting the way Jax organized the tool chest.

facts.fact: Jax 挖苦 Beau 盯着同一页看了五分钟（five minutes），并说他二十分钟前（twenty minutes ago）就已核对过。
Dad 找出一条原厂式上水管，并让 Beau 向 Carson 收十四点五美元（Charge her fourteen fifty）。
Dad 说 James 已去世五年（five years），但他仍把 James 的遗物当作明天可能走进车库的人的东西来对待。
facts.anchor: James was gone five years, and Dad still treated his belongings like pieces of somebody who might walk into the garage tomorrow.

facts.fact: Beau 说自己十七岁（seventeen）那年是最后一年在丰收节帮忙，记得搬干草还被吼。
facts.anchor: I was seventeen the last year I helped out there. I remember moving hay and being yelled at.

facts.fact: Dad 告诉 Beau，Carson 每年十月（every October）在农场忙得像拥有 Halloween 一样，十六岁（sixteen）时就戴着橙色头巾、支使成年男人。
facts.anchor: She ran around that place every October like she owned Halloween. Used to wear an orange bandanna in her hair and boss grown men around when she was sixteen.

facts.fact: Mom 在五点五十三分（five fifty-three）打电话说她在等，于是车行六点（six）关门；七分钟后（Seven minutes later）Jax 降下卷帘门。
facts.anchor: The shop closed at six. Not because Jax or I had finished everything. Because Mom called at five fifty-three and announced she was waiting.

facts.fact: Hunter 到场时不等 Clover 开口就从她手里接过两个箱子（two boxes），之后又在她掉之前接过第三个箱子（third box）。
facts.anchor: Hunter came around the truck and took two boxes from her without being asked.
